source.citation: Vogel, J.V. (1968). Inflow Performance Relationships for Solution-Gas Drive Wells. JPT 20(1), 83-92. doi:10.2118/1476-PA
source.digest_basis: SHA-256 identifies the unofficial convenience copy, not a publisher-hosted artifact.
source.example_locator: Use of Reference Curve, printed p. 89 (PDF page 7)
source.verification: Equation text and rendered example page read; numerical facts transcribed, PDF not redistributed.

units.pressure: psi (p. 89 example values as transcribed; gauge versus absolute datum not verified)

published_inputs_comment: All three inputs below are printed in the p. 89 example.
published_outputs_comment: p. 89 solution, not the subsequent prose's inconsistent 145 BOPD comparison. The exact qmax 162.5 lies on the display boundary of printed 162; no round-half-up convention is assumed.

acceptance.basis: Printed integer outputs use half a displayed BOPD plus the test arithmetic allowance of 1e-10 BOPD, including floating-point roundoff at the display boundary. Reproduction criterion only, not field accuracy.

pressure_datum_limitation: Ratios use the transcribed p. 89 values without a datum shift. The original page must be checked before assigning a gauge or absolute label; physical datum qualification is not established.
hand_calculation_comment: Independent substitution in Eq. (1): r=3/4 gives 1-0.15-0.45=0.4; 65/0.4=162.5. r=1/4 gives 1-0.05-0.05=0.9; 162.5*0.9=146.25. At r=0 and r=1 the factors are 1 and 0. The shut-in derivative gives PI=(0.2+2*0.8)*162.5/2000=0.14625. This PI is derived, not a published measurement, and is unused by from_test_point.
applicability: Two-phase solution-gas drive; pr <= pb. The example does not give pb; tests set pb=pr only as a constructed saturated boundary, not as measured source data. No field-accuracy qualification.
